openQuestions.question: Does boarding cost anything besides the wait and the ride (no fare is stated)? Can any person ride, or is the cell only, and are there limits for a wanted or recognised cell?
openQuestions.why: GDD §02 prices boarding in time only; anything further is undecided and not set in the timetable.

openQuestions.question: Can a cell be seen or reported while waiting on a platform or riding, which would add Trail or Alert risk to the time price?
openQuestions.why: Watchers stand at stations and stops, but the GDD does not say whether boarding is a witnessed act.

openQuestions.question: Do the trams and sky rail run through the whole mission clock, including the 5:40 to 8:00 handover window, and do they change with Alert or lockdown?
openQuestions.why: Headways are assumed constant; the GDD does not say service changes, and the plan questions raise the police sealing stations.

notes: Correction to last round: T3 was missing from lines and is now added; T1 and T2 do meet directly at Comet Row (T1/comet and T2/comet are an interchange pair), so a tram-to-tram trip need not go via the sky rail.
T1, T2, T3 tram speed 8 m/s (~29 km/h): stops are 300 to 320 m apart, so a run takes about 38 to 40 s, short but readable. [S]
S1 sky rail speed 14 m/s (~50 km/h): faster than the trams as an elevated trunk with 200 to 255 m station gaps, so it pays as the cross-city link. [S]
Tram dwell 20 s, sky rail dwell 15 s: paid only at pass-through stops, so it affects only journeys of 3 or more stops. [S]
Headway: trams 120 s, sky rail 90 s, since the trunk runs more often. Average wait is half a headway, so boarding costs 45 to 60 s before the ride. [S]

Interchange pairs used: T1/circus-S1/circus, T2/harbour-S1/harbour, T3/sunset-S1/sunset, T1/comet-T2/comet. Journeys cover the likely cross-city trips, including Rocket Lane (the getaway street) to Harbour Lane.
